name: preview__FluidComboBox

props.name: direction
props.description: Specify the direction of the dropdown. Can be either top or bottom.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Specify whether the `<input>` should be disabled

props.name: initialSelectedItem
props.description: Allow users to pass in an arbitrary item or a string (in case their items are an array of strings) from their collection that are pre-selected

props.name: invalid
props.description: Specify if the currently selected value is invalid.

props.name: invalidText
props.description: Provide the text that is displayed when the control is in an invalid state

props.name: isCondensed
props.description: Specify if the `FluidComboBox` should render its menu items in condensed mode

props.name: itemToString
props.description: Helper function passed to downshift that allows the library to render a given item to a string label. By default, it extracts the `label` field from a given item to serve as the item label in the list.

props.name: items
props.description: We try to stay as generic as possible here to allow individuals to pass in a collection of whatever kind of data structure they prefer

props.name: label
props.description: Generic `label` that will be used as the textual representation of what this field is for

props.name: selectedItem
props.description: In the case you want to control the dropdown selection entirely.

props.name: titleText
props.description: Provide the title text that will be read by a screen reader when visiting this control

props.name: warn
props.description: Specify whether the control is currently in warning state

props.name: warnText
props.description: Provide the text that is displayed when the control is in warning state

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon preview__FluidComboBox rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
